title: pilosella leucotricha
intro: Pilosella leucotricha, commonly known as White-flowered Mouse-ear, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and treating various skin conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella leucotricha include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
